selection_reason: purposive major-disaster cases with official document archives, two shared event groups, all in continuing 103-council subset; not representative or selected by outcome
primary_outcome: (actual routine maintenance - original planned routine maintenance) / original planned routine maintenance
gate: same routine asset/fund/work scope; planned amount fixed before disaster; disaster reconstruction excluded with documentary evidence; positive denominator; unit and annual period verified
comparison_screen: pre-event fiscal/maintenance/scale only; later exposure used solely to exclude contaminated controls; unknown hazard not zero
interactions_prespecified: disaster x cash cover below 3 months
disaster x prior operating ratio below 0 percent
inference_gate: comparable routine outcome for treated and controls with >=3 pre-event years; no clearly incompatible pre-trends; enough independent council/event clusters and untreated observations for credible uncertainty; no models merely to fill output files
funding_gate: verified effective date and first council payment date, amount, project/event linkage; do not use announcements as payments
freeze_rule: all existing files, including repository index, remain unchanged
